title: "Main Das Aaiyaan Bazaraan Wich Lyrics Punjabi 2021 Latest"
language: "Panjabi"
lang: "pa"
direction: "ltr"

poet: "Jaun"

1
Main Das Aayiyaan Bazaraan Wich Assi Bagi Nayi Meri Maa Da Naam Batool Aye.
Jinay Khanjar De Heth Namaz Parhi Manwa Aayi Aan Oh Deen Da Pak Usool Aye.
Mainu Dukh Renrein Darbar De Wich Main Aakhdi Rayi.
Mainu Sar Uryan Pe Wekhday Oh Tusi Janrday Nayi Mera Nana Pak Rasool Aye.

2
Main Fateh Saan Par Dil Mera Piya Ronda Si.
Main Veer Apne Da Katiya Sar Jadon Shamiyaan Taun Kita Chadraan Naal Wasool Aye.
Saday Sabar Da Naa Hai Sabit Rab Da Sabar Howay.
Jehra Nabiyaan Sabar Wakhaya Nayi Oh Chadraan De Asaan Kita Sabar Qabool Aye.

3
Main Aakhdi Rayi Sar Veer Da Tak Ke Nezay Te.
Loko Quran Da Ainj Te Nayi Mere Nanay De Hoya Dil Te Pak Nazool Aye.
Haye Sham Wichon Kiwein Jaun Oh Zindah Aa Gayi Aye.
Asghar Taun Le Shabbir Taein Jis Bibi Da Hoya Ghar Da Ghar Maqtool Aye.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/main-das-aaiyaan-bazaraan-wich-lyrics-punjabi-2021-latest-tajpoint-b8931ee95bbeb4440866.md')
_, meta, source = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].strip()
for verse_text, nums in [(roman, '123'), (source, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = verse_text.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 3
    for block, num in zip(blocks, nums):
        number, *verses = block.splitlines()
        assert number.strip() == num and len(verses) == 4
        assert all(verse.strip() and not verse.endswith('.') for verse in verses)
print('Both editions contain three matching four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi, preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, and verified that both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

The Roman reading `Renrein` is ambiguous. I rendered it phonetically as `رین ریں`.
